doc.markdown:
Exact reads from raw callback sources without losing simultaneous data/status.
A full final prefix succeeds even when that callback also reports an error.
Short failure retains the advanced source. A zero-progress nonterminal source
is retried; a source that never progresses can therefore keep the call waiting.
These operations do not attest to source randomness or cryptographic quality.
